common.ctaTalkBusiness: Talk to Us About Your Business

hero.title:
The founder brings the vision,
Nukta runs the operation.
hero.subtitle: We run production, branding, marketing, technology, customer support and business operations through one connected system, so founders can focus on growth and decision-making.

problem.title: Where is your business getting stuck as it grows?
items: Marketing is running, but sales aren't consistent
There's a team, but no clear system
Content, design and operations are scattered
Customer response and follow-up are weak
The founder is managing everything alone
There's data, but no actionable reporting
problem.quote: "The problem isn't only marketing. Growth is often held back by operations inside the business."

whoItsFor.title: Who is Nukta for?
whoItsFor.subtitle: Nukta is for founders and brands who want to grow, but whose pace is slowed by scattered execution, team pressure or operational complexity.

audiences.title: New Founder
audiences.desc: You have an idea or product, but no complete execution structure to launch it.

audiences.title: Growing Brand
audiences.desc: Sales are coming in, but marketing, content, team and operations aren't consistent.

audiences.title: Overloaded Founder
audiences.desc: The founder spends a large share of their time solving daily operational problems.

audiences.title: Established Business
audiences.desc: There's an existing team, but it needs a stronger system, automation, reporting and accountability.

whoItsNotFor.title: Nukta isn't for everyone
whoItsNotFor.desc: Nukta believes in structured execution, transparency and long-term business improvement.
points: Those who want guaranteed overnight results
Those who won't share necessary business information
Those who won't follow responsibility or approval processes
Those who are only looking for the lowest-price vendor
whoItsNotFor.quote: "The right partnership is built on shared commitment, clear communication and realistic expectations."

founderRole.title: So what does the founder do?
founderRole.quote:
"The founder's job isn't to manage everything.
The founder's job is to set direction."

profitSharing.title: Why is our model different?
points: Core product and brand remain the founder's
Nukta grows only when the business grows
profitSharing.note: The profit-sharing structure is set according to the project, responsibilities, investment and agreement.

accountability.title: How We Ensure Accountability
accountability.subtitle: Through clear responsibility, defined deadlines, structured reporting and regular review, the progress and outcome of every task stays visible.

principles.title: Clear Responsibility
principles.desc: Every task has a single, named owner.

principles.title: Defined Deadline
principles.desc: When a task will be done is set at the very start.

principles.title: Structured Reporting
principles.desc: Progress, blockers and outcomes are reported regularly.

principles.title: Review & Feedback
principles.desc: Work is reviewed and corrected or improved as needed.

principles.title: Continuous Improvement
principles.desc: Processes are improved so the same mistake doesn't happen twice.

accountability.quote: "We don't just start the work. We follow through on its responsibility, progress and results."
